items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: And then I told him about my friend, Manny Sears.

ctx.x: Ask him if it was before World War II, Ponce.

Was it before World War II? Yeah, yeah. Before that. You see, when I was there, I don't know what I mean. I can't hide more than any banjo or guitar player in the city. Everybody wants me to play with them, you know. And I used to play with them, but my band wasn't doing nothing. But when I was over there in Sweetsburg, they was just waiting for me to come back so they could tell me to Florida. Let me see what part that was, what part of Florida? Mommy's Florida. And then I told him about my friend, Manny Sears.…
Ask me if he was playing with Louis Dumaine after he went to Mexico or before he went to Mexico.
